## 1. Load and prepare data

Load hourly passive acoustic detections, active acoustic krill swarm metrics,
sea ice draft, and light (solar/lunar) data. Derive key variables used throughout
the analysis.

```{r load-packages, cache=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

# --- Libraries ----------------------------------------------------------------
library(mgcv)       # GAMs
library(ggplot2)    # plotting
library(tidyr)      # data reshaping
library(plotly)     # interactive plots
library(here)       # relative file paths
library(cluster)    # clustering
library(factoextra) # clustering visualisation
library(scales)     # axis formatting
library(viridis)    # colour palettes
library(patchwork)  # combining plots
library(gratia)     # GAM utilities
library(knitr)      # table formatting
library(ggpubr)     # publication-ready plots with stat comparisons
library(suncalc)    # sunrise/sunset times
library(ggh4x)      # per-facet axis scales

if (!require(purrr)) install.packages("purrr")
library(dplyr)      # data manipulation
```


```{r load-data, cache=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# --- File paths ---------------------------------------------------------------
#data_dir  <- "c:\\Users\\DCCEEW\\Documents\\AcousticPreyFieldSegregation-main\\"# "C:/Users/abbie_smi/OneDrive - Antarctic/Data/R/KOMBI03 whales/GAM - Brian/clean"
#func_path <- file.path(data_dir, "log-normCIs.R")
#dat_file  <- file.path(data_dir, "TT_align_swarm_regioncells.csv")

# Source log-normal confidence interval helper function
source(here::here('R', "log-normCIs.R"))

# --- Load data ----------------------------------------------------------------
#dat <- read.csv(dat_file)
dat<-read.csv(here::here('data','TT_align_swarm_regioncells.csv'))
# --- Time variables -----------------------------------------------------------
dat$timeStamp  <- as.POSIXct(dat$timeVec, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")
#dat$timeStamp  <- as.POSIXct(dat$dt, format = "%d/%m/%Y %H:%M", tz = "UTC")

dat$hour       <- as.numeric(format(dat$timeStamp, "%H"))
dat$day_of_year <- as.numeric(format(dat$timeStamp, "%j"))
dat$month      <- as.integer(format(dat$timeStamp, "%m"))
summary(dat$day_of_year)

# --- Krill presence-absence and density ---------------------------------------
# Binary krill presence (1 = detected, 0 = absent)
dat$krill_PA=0
dat$krill_PA[dat$rho_v>0]=1
table(dat$krill_PA)

# Add half the minimum detectable density to avoid zeros in log/Gamma models
min_det    <- min(dat$rho_v[dat$krill_PA == 1])
dat$rho_min <- dat$rho_v + min_det / 2

# Max krill density diagnostics
max(dat$rho_v, na.rm = TRUE)
dat$timeVec[which.max(dat$rho_v)]
dat$Center_of_mass[which.max(dat$rho_v)]

# --- Centre of mass: replace NaN with background value of 200 m --------------
dat$Center_of_mass_min <- 200
dat$Center_of_mass_min[!is.nan(dat$Center_of_mass)] <-
  dat$Center_of_mass[!is.nan(dat$Center_of_mass)]
plot(dat$Center_of_mass_min)

# --- Sea ice ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Convert ice variable to draft (m); negative values set to zero (open water)
dat$ice <- dat$Diff - 1
dat$ice[dat$ice < 0] <- 0
```


## 2. Predator presence and state assignment

Assign hourly presence/absence for Antarctic blue whales (ABW) and Antarctic
minke whales (AMW) using seasonal false positive rate thresholds from Table S1.
Classify each hour into one of four mutually exclusive predator states.

```{r predator-presence, cache=TRUE, dependson="load-data"}
# --- Seasonal false positive rates (from Table S1) ----------------------------
# Rates vary by month; applied as thresholds relative to maximum call counts
Bm_Ant_ABZ_rate <- c(rep(0.040, 2), rep(0.556, 3), rep(0.500, 3), rep(0.154, 3), 0.040)
Bm_D_rate       <- c(rep(0.017, 2), rep(0,     3), rep(0.476, 3), rep(0.021, 3), 0.017)
BD_rate         <- c(rep(0,     2), rep(0.077, 3), rep(0.202, 3), rep(0.159, 3), 0    )

seasonal_fpr <- data.frame(
  month           = 1:12,
  Bm_Ant_ABZ_rate = Bm_Ant_ABZ_rate,
  Bm_D_rate       = Bm_D_rate,
  BD_rate         = BD_rate
)

# Merge monthly false positive rates onto main data
dat <- merge(dat, seasonal_fpr, by = "month", all.x = TRUE)

# --- Presence/absence based on FPR thresholds ---------------------------------
# ABW present if either song (Bm_Ant_ABZ) or downsweep (Bm_D) exceeds threshold
dat$ABW_presence <- ifelse(
  dat$Bm_Ant_ABZ > max(dat$Bm_Ant_ABZ, na.rm = TRUE) * dat$Bm_Ant_ABZ_rate |
  dat$Bm_D       > max(dat$Bm_D,       na.rm = TRUE) * dat$Bm_D_rate,
  1, 0
)

# AMW present if bioduck call (BD) exceeds threshold
dat$AMW_presence <- ifelse(
  dat$BD > max(dat$BD, na.rm = TRUE) * dat$BD_rate,
  1, 0
)

# --- Predator state classification --------------------------------------------
# Four mutually exclusive states based on ABW and AMW presence/absence
dat$predator_state <- "none"
dat$predator_state[dat$ABW_presence == 1 & dat$AMW_presence == 0] <- "ABW_only"
dat$predator_state[dat$ABW_presence == 0 & dat$AMW_presence == 1] <- "AMW_only"
dat$predator_state[dat$ABW_presence == 1 & dat$AMW_presence == 1] <- "both"

# Convert to ordered factor with sample sizes in labels
dat$predator_state <- factor(
  dat$predator_state,
  levels = c("none", "AMW_only", "ABW_only", "both"),
  labels = c("None (n=6291)", "AMW only (n=1033)", "ABW only (n=1296)", "Both (n=22)")
)
summary(dat$predator_state)  # verify n matches labels

# Percentage of deployment with predator overlap
22 / (6291 + 1033 + 1296 + 22) * 100
```


## 3. Diel classification

Classify each hour as day or night based on local sunrise/sunset times computed
for the mooring location using the `suncalc` package.

```{r diel-classification, cache=TRUE, dependson="predator-presence"}
# --- Sunrise/sunset for mooring location (UTC) --------------------------------
deployment_lat <- -66.0
deployment_lon <-  70.0

sun_times <- getSunlightTimes(
  date = as.Date(dat$timeStamp),
  lat  = deployment_lat,
  lon  = deployment_lon,
  keep = c("sunrise", "sunset"),
  tz   = "UTC"
)

dat$sunrise <- sun_times$sunrise
dat$sunset  <- sun_times$sunset

# Classify as Day if timeStamp falls between sunrise and sunset; else Night
# Note: NAs occur during polar day/night; assign manually if needed
dat$diel <- ifelse(
  dat$timeStamp >= dat$sunrise & dat$timeStamp <= dat$sunset,
  "Day", "Night"
)
dat$diel <- factor(dat$diel, levels = c("Day", "Night"))

# Check balance across predator states
table(dat$diel, dat$predator_state)
```


## 4. Predator-overlap periods

Identify calendar periods when ABW and AMW co-occur, and collapse them into
date ranges for shading in time series figures.

```{r overlap-periods}
# Days when both predators are present simultaneously
overlap_days <- dat %>%
  filter(predator_state == "Both (n=22)") %>%
  pull(day_of_year)
overlap_days

overlap_dates <- as.Date(overlap_days, origin = "2021-01-01")
overlap_dates

# Collapse consecutive dates into start/end ranges for geom_rect shading
overlap_ranges <- overlap_dates %>%
  sort() %>%
  { data.frame(
      start = .[c(TRUE, diff(.) != 1)],
      end   = .[c(diff(.) != 1, TRUE)]
    )
  }
overlap_ranges
```


## 5. Krill swarm properties by predator state

Summarise median krill density, thickness and centre of mass depth for each
predator state, separately for day and night. Compute ratios relative to the
no-predator baseline to quantify effect sizes.

```{r swarm-summary-stats}
# Helper to compute medians and ratios relative to "no predator" baseline
summarise_swarm <- function(data, period) {
  stats <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(diel), diel == period) %>%
    group_by(predator_state) %>%
    summarise(
      med_density   = median(rho_min,        na.rm = TRUE),
      med_thickness = median(Thickness_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      med_depth     = median(Center_of_mass, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  baseline <- stats %>% filter(predator_state == "None (n=6291)")

  stats %>%
    mutate(
      density_ratio   = med_density   / baseline$med_density,
      thickness_ratio = med_thickness / baseline$med_thickness,
      depth_ratio     = med_depth     / baseline$med_depth,
      period          = period
    )
}

day_ratios   <- summarise_swarm(dat, "Day")
night_ratios <- summarise_swarm(dat, "Night")

day_ratios
night_ratios
```


## 6. Figure 3 — Diel boxplots of krill swarm properties

Boxplots comparing krill swarm density (log10), centre of mass depth, and
mean thickness across predator states, split by diel period (Day vs Night).
Wilcoxon pairwise tests compare each predator state to the no-predator baseline.

```{r figure3-diel-boxplots, fig.height=12, fig.width=9}
# Shared plot settings
my_comparisons2 <- list(c(1, 2), c(1, 3), c(1, 4))  # baseline vs each predator state
labs <- sapply(levels(dat$predator_state),            # strip sample sizes from labels
               function(x) strsplit(x, split = " \\(n")[[1]][1])

# Log10-transform density for visualisation
dat$log10rho_min <- log10(dat$rho_min)

# --- A/B: Krill density (log10) -----------------------------------------------
pr_day <- dat %>%
  filter(!is.na(diel), diel == "Day") %>%
  select(predator_state, log10rho_min) %>%
  ggboxplot(x = "predator_state", y = "log10rho_min",
            color = "predator_state",
            palette = c("#888888", "#FFA500", "#800080", "#DC143C"),
            add = "jitter") +
  ylim(c(0, 5)) +
  stat_compare_means(label.y = 4.5) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = my_comparisons2, label.y = c(3, 3.5, 4)) +
  xlab("Predator state") + ylab("log10 Density") +
```

## 7. Figure 2 — Observational time series

Multi-panel time series showing: (a) solar and lunar irradiance, (b) sea ice
draft, (c) krill swarm properties, and (d–f) whale call detection rates.
Grey shading marks periods when ABW and AMW co-occur.

```{r figure2-timeseries, fig.height=14, fig.width=10}
# --- A: Solar and lunar irradiance --------------------------------------------
# Scale lunar lux to solar axis for dual-axis display
solar_max    <- max(dat$solar_lux, na.rm = TRUE)
lunar_max    <- max(dat$lunar_lux, na.rm = TRUE)
scale_factor <- solar_max / lunar_max

p1 <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = timeStamp)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = solar_lux),                  colour = "#FFD700", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_col(aes(y = lunar_lux * scale_factor),   colour = "#6A0DAD", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name      = "Solar (lux)",
    sec.axis  = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor, name = "Lunar (lux)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y.left  = element_text(color = "#FFD700"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "#6A0DAD"),
    axis.text.y.right  = element_text(color = "#6A0DAD"),
    axis.text.y.left   = element_text(color = "#FFD700")
  ) +
  ggtitle("a) Solar irradiance and Lunar illuminance")

# --- B: Sea ice draft ---------------------------------------------------------
# Open-water hours overlaid as light blue rectangles
zero_ice       <- dat[dat$ice == 0, ]
dat$ice_status <- ifelse(dat$ice == 0, "Open water", "Ice covered")

p2 <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = timeStamp, y = ice, fill = ice_status)) +
  geom_col(colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.1) +
  geom_rect(                              # open-water highlight
    data        = zero_ice,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    aes(xmin = timeStamp, xmax = timeStamp + 3600, ymin = -3, ymax = 1),
    fill  = "lightblue",
    alpha = 1
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values       = c("Open water" = "lightblue", "Ice covered" = "grey30"),
    na.translate = FALSE,
    name         = NULL
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse(name = "Sea ice draft (m)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        legend.title    = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.text     = element_text(size = 9)) +
  ggtitle("b) Sea ice draft")

# --- C: Krill swarm properties (depth, density, thickness) -------------------
p3 <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = timeStamp, y = Center_of_mass,
                      colour = rho_v, size = Thickness_mean)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_rect(                              # overlap period shading
    data        = overlap_ranges,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    aes(xmin = as.POSIXct(start - 1, origin = "2021-01-01", tz = "UTC"),
        xmax = as.POSIXct(end,       origin = "2021-01-01", tz = "UTC"),
        ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    fill  = "grey30",
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse(name = "Centre of Mass (m)") +
  scale_colour_viridis(
    option   = "plasma",
    na.value = "grey80",
    limits   = c(0, 100),
    oob      = scales::squish,
    name     = expression("Density (g m"^-3*")")
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 5), name = "Thickness (m)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  ggtitle("c) Krill swarms")

# Helper to build whale call panels (D, E, F) with consistent formatting
make_call_panel <- function(data, y_var, colour, title, overlap_ranges) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = timeStamp, y = .data[[y_var]])) +
    geom_col(colour = colour, linewidth = 1) +
    geom_rect(
      data        = overlap_ranges,
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      aes(xmin = as.POSIXct(start - 1, origin = "2021-01-01", tz = "UTC"),
          xmax = as.POSIXct(end,       origin = "2021-01-01", tz = "UTC"),
          ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
      fill  = "grey30",
      alpha = 0.3
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    labs(y = "Detections/hr", title = title)
}

p4 <- make_call_panel(dat, "Bm_Ant_ABZ", "#800080", "d) ABW song",       overlap_ranges)
p5 <- make_call_panel(dat, "Bm_D",       "#CC4678", "e) ABW downsweeps", overlap_ranges)
p6 <- make_call_panel(dat, "BD",         "#FFA500", "f) AMW bioduck",    overlap_ranges)

# --- Combine panels -----------------------------------------------------------
combined_plot <- (p1 / p2 / p3 / p4 / p5 / p6) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title   = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold")
  )
combined_plot
```


## 8. Whale call GAMs

Fit GAMs to hourly call detection rates for ABW song (m1), ABW downsweeps (m2),
and AMW bioduck (m3). Covariates: hour of day, day of year (both cyclic splines),
solar irradiance, lunar irradiance, and sea ice draft.
Gaussian with log link used for count-like rate data.

```{r whale-gams, cache=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# --- m1: ABW song (Bm_Ant_ABZ) -----------------------------------------------
m1 <- gam(
  Bm_Ant_ABZ ~
    s(hour,        k = 15, bs = "cc") +   # cyclic: hour of day
    s(day_of_year, k = 15, bs = "cc") +   # cyclic: day of year
    s(solar_lux,   k = 6,  bs = "cr") +
    s(lunar_lux,   k = 6,  bs = "cr") +
    s(ice,         k = 6,  bs = "cr"),
  data   = dat,
  method = "ML",
  family = gaussian(link = "log"),
  gamma  = 1.4,                           # penalise complexity
  select = FALSE,
  knots  = list(hour = c(0, 24), day_of_year = c(0, 365))
)
summary(m1)

# --- m2: ABW downsweeps (Bm_D) -----------------------------------------------
m2 <- gam(
  Bm_D ~
    s(hour,        k = 15, bs = "cc") +
    s(day_of_year, k = 15, bs = "cc") +
    s(solar_lux,   k = 6,  bs = "cr") +
    s(lunar_lux,   k = 6,  bs = "cr") +
    s(ice,         k = 6,  bs = "cr"),
  data   = dat,
  method = "ML",
  family = gaussian(link = "log"),
  gamma  = 1.4,
  select = TRUE,                          # automatic term selection
  knots  = list(hour = c(0, 24), day_of_year = c(0, 365))
)
summary(m2)

# --- m3: AMW bioduck (BD) -----------------------------------------------------
m3 <- gam(
  BD ~
    s(hour,        k = 15, bs = "cc") +
    s(day_of_year, k = 15, bs = "cc") +
    s(solar_lux,   k = 6,  bs = "cr") +
    s(lunar_lux,   k = 6,  bs = "cr") +
    s(ice,         k = 6,  bs = "cr"),
  data   = dat,
  method = "ML",
  family = gaussian(link = "log"),
  gamma  = 1.4,
  select = TRUE,
  knots  = list(hour = c(0, 24), day_of_year = c(0, 365))
)
summary(m3)

# --- Predictions at mean covariate values across day of year -----------------
preds <- data.frame(
  hour        = mean(dat$hour),
  day_of_year = 0:365,
  solar_lux   = mean(dat$solar_lux, na.rm = TRUE),
  lunar_lux   = mean(dat$lunar_lux, na.rm = TRUE),
  ice         = mean(dat$ice,       na.rm = TRUE),
  BD = mean(dat$BD,na.rm=T),
  Bm_D=mean(dat$Bm_D,na.rm=T)
)

preds_m1 <- as.data.frame(predict(m1, newdata = preds, type = "response", se.fit = TRUE))
preds_m1$model <- "Bm_Ant_ABZ"

preds_m2 <- as.data.frame(predict(m2, newdata = preds, type = "response", se.fit = TRUE))
preds_m2$model <- "Bm_D"

preds_m3 <- as.data.frame(predict(m3, newdata = preds, type = "response", se.fit = TRUE))
preds_m3$model <- "BD"

preds_all <- rbind(preds_m1, preds_m2, preds_m3)
preds_all$day_of_year <- preds$day_of_year
preds_all$lower       <- preds_all$fit - 2 * preds_all$se.fit  # approx 95% CI
preds_all$upper       <- preds_all$fit + 2 * preds_all$se.fit

# Quick plot of whale call model predictions
ggplot(data = preds_all,
       aes(x = as.Date(day_of_year, origin = "2021-01-01"),
           y = fit, colour = model, group = model)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = model),
              alpha = 0.4, colour = NA) +
  facet_grid(model ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(y = "Predicted call rate (n/hr)", x = "Month") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```


## 9. Krill swarm GAMs

Fit GAMs to krill density, centre of mass depth, and mean thickness using
the same environmental covariates as the whale call models (no whale terms).
Gamma family with log link appropriate for positive continuous response variables.

#```{r krill-gam-nan}
#summary(dat$rho_min)
#summary(dat$Center_of_mass)
#summary(dat$Thickness_mean)
#```

```{r krill-gams, fig.height=7.9, fig.width=6.3, cache=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, dependson=c("load-data", "predator-presence", "diel-classification")}
# --- Krill density ------------------------------------------------------------
mdensity <- gam(
  rho_min ~
    s(hour,        k = 15, bs = "cc") +
    s(day_of_year, k = 15, bs = "cc") +
    s(solar_lux,   k = 6,  bs = "cr") +
    s(lunar_lux,   k = 6,  bs = "cr") +
    s(ice,         k = 6,  bs = "cr"),
  data   = dat,
  method = "ML",
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  gamma  = 1.4,
  select = TRUE,
  knots  = list(hour = c(0, 24), day_of_year = c(0, 365))
)
summary(mdensity)
gam.check(mdensity)
concurvity(mdensity)

mdensity_BD<-update(mdensity, .~. + s(BD,k=6,bs='cr'))
concurvity(mdensity_BD)
summary(mdensity_BD)

mdensity_BD_Bm_D<-update(mdensity_BD, .~. + s(Bm_D,k=6,bs='cr'))
concurvity(mdensity_BD_Bm_D)
summary(mdensity_BD_Bm_D)
plot(mdensity_BD_Bm_D,pages=1)

mdensity_BD_Bm_D_Bm_Ant_ABZ<-update(mdensity_BD_Bm_D, .~. + s(Bm_Ant_ABZ,k=6,bs='cr')) #I'd probably not put Bm_Ant_ABZ
concurvity(mdensity_BD_Bm_D_Bm_Ant_ABZ)
plot(mdensity_BD_Bm_D_Bm_Ant_ABZ,pages=1)
#over write the mdensity model object with mdensity_BD_Bm_D
mdensitySTORE <- mdensity
mdensity <- mdensity_BD_Bm_D
# --- Centre of mass depth -------------------Bm_D_rate# --- Centre of mass depth -----------------------------------------------------
mcom <- gam(
  Center_of_mass ~
    s(hour,        k = 15, bs = "cc") +
    s(day_of_year, k = 15, bs = "cc") +
    s(solar_lux,   k = 6,  bs = "cr") +
    s(lunar_lux,   k = 6,  bs = "cr") +
    s(ice,         k = 6,  bs = "cr"),
  data   = dat,
  method = "ML",
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  gamma  = 1.4,
  select = TRUE,
  knots  = list(hour = c(0, 24), day_of_year = c(0, 365))
)
summary(mcom)
gam.check(mcom)
concurvity(mcom)

mcom_BD<-update(mcom, .~. + s(BD,k=6,bs='cr'))
concurvity(mcom_BD)
summary(mcom_BD)

mcom_BD_Bm_D<-update(mcom_BD, .~. + s(Bm_D,k=6,bs='cr'))
concurvity(mcom_BD_Bm_D)
summary(mcom_BD_Bm_D)
plot(mcom_BD_Bm_D,pages=1)

mcom_BD_Bm_D_Bm_Ant_ABZ<-update(mcom_BD_Bm_D, .~. + s(Bm_Ant_ABZ,k=6,bs='cr')) #I'd probably not put Bm_Ant_ABZ
concurvity(mcom_BD_Bm_D_Bm_Ant_ABZ)
plot(mcom_BD_Bm_D_Bm_Ant_ABZ,pages=1)

#over write the mcom model object with mcom_BD_Bm_D
mcomSTORE <- mcom
mcom <- mcom_BD_Bm_D


# --- Mean swarm thickness -----------------------------------------------------
mthickness <- gam(
  Thickness_mean ~
    s(hour,        k = 15, bs = "cc") +
    s(day_of_year, k = 15, bs = "cc") +
    s(solar_lux,   k = 6,  bs = "cr") +
    s(lunar_lux,   k = 6,  bs = "cr") +
    s(ice,         k = 6,  bs = "cr"),
  data   = dat,
  method = "ML",
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  gamma  = 1.4,
  select = TRUE,
  knots  = list(hour = c(0, 24), day_of_year = c(0, 365))
)
summary(mthickness)
gam.check(mthickness)
concurvity(mthickness)

mthickness_BD<-update(mthickness, .~. + s(BD,k=6,bs='cr'))
concurvity(mthickness_BD)
summary(mthickness_BD)

mthickness_BD_Bm_D<-update(mthickness_BD, .~. + s(Bm_D,k=6,bs='cr'))
concurvity(mthickness_BD_Bm_D)
summary(mthickness_BD_Bm_D)
plot(mthickness_BD_Bm_D,pages=1)

mthickness_BD_Bm_D_Bm_Ant_ABZ<-update(mthickness_BD_Bm_D, .~. + s(Bm_Ant_ABZ,k=6,bs='cr')) #I'd probably not put Bm_Ant_ABZ
concurvity(mthickness_BD_Bm_D_Bm_Ant_ABZ)
plot(mthickness_BD_Bm_D_Bm_Ant_ABZ,pages=1)

#over write the mthickness model object with mthickness_BD_Bm_D
mthicknessSTORE <- mthickness
mthickness <- mthickness_BD_Bm_D



# --- Combine all model predictions --------------------------------------------
preds_mdensity <- as.data.frame(
  predict(mdensity,   newdata = preds, type = "response", se.fit = TRUE))
preds_mdensity$model <- "krill_density"

preds_mcom <- as.data.frame(
  predict(mcom,       newdata = preds, type = "response", se.fit = TRUE))
preds_mcom$model <- "centre_of_mass"

preds_mthickness <- as.data.frame(
  predict(mthickness, newdata = preds, type = "response", se.fit = TRUE))
preds_mthickness$model <- "corrected_thickness"

# Combine whale and krill predictions into a single data frame
preds_all2 <- rbind(preds_m1, preds_m2, preds_m3,
                    preds_mdensity, preds_mthickness, preds_mcom)
preds_all2$day_of_year <- rep(0:365, 6)
preds_all2$lower       <- preds_all2$fit - 2 * preds_all2$se.fit
preds_all2$upper       <- preds_all2$fit + 2 * preds_all2$se.fit

# Order models for facet display (krill first, then whale calls)
preds_all2$model <- factor(
  preds_all2$model,
  levels = c("krill_density", "centre_of_mass", "corrected_thickness",
             "Bm_Ant_ABZ", "Bm_D", "BD")
)

# Facet strip labels
my_labels <- as_labeller(c(
  krill_density        = "Krill density\n(g/m^3)",
  centre_of_mass       = "Centre of mass\ndepth (m)",
  corrected_thickness  = "Thickness\n(m)",
  Bm_Ant_ABZ           = "ABW Song\n(Detections/h)",
  Bm_D                 = "Downsweep\n(Detections/h)",
  BD                   = "Bioduck\n(Detections/h)"
))
```


## 11. Prediction statistics

Compute summary statistics from GAM predictions: mean density, peak-day lag
between ABW song and krill density, and seasonal summaries of model fits.

```{r prediction-stats}
# Mean predicted krill density across the year
mean(preds_all2$fit[preds_all2$model == "krill_density"])

# Approximate lag (days) between ABW song peak and krill density peak
lags <- preds_all2 %>%
  filter(model %in% c("Bm_Ant_ABZ", "krill_density")) %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(peak_day = day_of_year[which.max(fit)], .groups = "drop") %>%
  summarise(lag_days = diff(peak_day))
lags

# Assign austral seasons to each prediction day
preds_all3 <- preds_all2 %>%
  mutate(season = case_when(
    day_of_year >= 80  & day_of_year < 172 ~ "spring",  # Mar 21 – Jun 20
    day_of_year >= 172 & day_of_year < 264 ~ "summer",  # Jun 21 – Sep 20
    day_of_year >= 264 & day_of_year < 355 ~ "autumn",  # Sep 21 – Dec 20
    TRUE                                   ~ "winter"   # Dec 21 – Mar 20
  ))

# Seasonal mean fit and uncertainty per model
seasonal_summary <- preds_all3 %>%
  group_by(model, season) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_fit = mean(fit,    na.rm = TRUE),
    se_fit   = mean(se.fit, na.rm = TRUE),
    lower_ci = mean(lower,  na.rm = TRUE),
    upper_ci = mean(upper,  na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
seasonal_summary

# Peak krill density with 95% CI (top ~18% of predicted values as proxy for peak period)
sort(unique(preds_all2$fit  [preds_all2$model == "krill_density"]), decreasing = TRUE)[65]
sort(unique(preds_all2$lower[preds_all2$model == "krill_density"]), decreasing = TRUE)[65]
sort(unique(preds_all2$upper[preds_all2$model == "krill_density"]), decreasing = TRUE)[65]
```


## 12. Figure 4 — GAM predictions with seasonal clustering

Hierarchical clustering of daily GAM predictions identifies two seasonal
regimes (e.g., summer vs winter). Predictions are coloured by cluster
assignment to highlight regime boundaries across all six model variables.

```{r figure4-clustering, fig.height=12, fig.width=8}
# --- Hierarchical clustering on scaled GAM predictions -----------------------
# Reshape to wide format: one row per day, one column per model
wide_preds <- reshape(
  preds_all2[, c("day_of_year", "fit", "model")],
  timevar   = "model",
  idvar     = "day_of_year",
  direction = "wide"
)

pred_matrix    <- wide_preds[, -1]          # remove day_of_year column
scaled_matrix  <- scale(pred_matrix)        # z-score normalise
dist_matrix    <- dist(scaled_matrix, method = "euclidean")
hc             <- hclust(dist_matrix, method = "ward.D2")

# Visualise dendrogram and optimal cluster number
plot(hc, main = "Hierarchical Clustering of GAM Predictions",
     xlab = "Days", sub = "")
fviz_nbclust(as.matrix(dist_matrix), FUN = hcut,
             method = "silhouette", hc_method = "average")

# Cut tree into 2 clusters (summer vs winter regime)
clusters           <- cutree(hc, k = 2)
wide_preds$cluster <- clusters

# Reshape back to long format for plotting; add run_id to track cluster transitions
long_preds <- wide_preds %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = starts_with("fit"),
    names_to  = "variable",
    values_to = "fit"
  ) %>%
  mutate(variable = sub("^fit\\.", "", variable)) %>%
  arrange(variable, day_of_year) %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  mutate(run_id = cumsum(cluster != lag(cluster, default = first(cluster)))) %>%
  ungroup()

# Cluster summary table
cluster_summary <- long_preds %>%
  group_by(cluster, variable) %>%
  summarise(
    n_days    = n_distinct(day_of_year),
    mean_fit  = mean(fit, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_fit    = sd(fit,   na.rm = TRUE),
    start_day = min(day_of_year),
    end_day   = max(day_of_year),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(cluster, variable)
kable(cluster_summary, digits = 2,
      caption = "Summary of cluster properties")

# Attach cluster and run_id to main predictions data frame
preds_all2$cluster <- long_preds$cluster
preds_all2$run_id  <- long_preds$run_id

# --- Plot with cluster colouring ---------------------------------------------
ggplot(data = preds_all2,
       aes(x     = as.Date(day_of_year, origin = "2021-01-01"),
           y     = fit,
           group = interaction(cluster, run_id),
           color = factor(cluster),
           fill  = factor(cluster))) +
  # Predator overlap shading
  geom_rect(
    data        = overlap_ranges,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    aes(xmin = as.Date(start - 1, origin = "2021-01-01"),
        xmax = as.Date(end,       origin = "2021-01-01"),
        ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    fill  = "grey30",
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.4, colour = NA) +
  facet_wrap(model ~ .,
             scales         = "free_y",
             nrow           = length(unique(preds_all2$model)),
             strip.position = "left",
             labeller       = my_labels) +
  # Reverse y-axis for centre of mass panel only
  facetted_pos_scales(y = list(
    model == "centre_of_mass" ~ scale_y_reverse()
  )) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b",
               limits = c(as.Date("2021-03-01"), as.Date("2022-01-31"))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1" = "#0D0887", "2" = "#F87C36")) +
  scale_fill_manual( values = c("1" = "#0D0887", "2" = "#F87C36")) +
  ylab(NULL) + xlab(NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Hierarchical partitioning - drivers of krill swarms 
```{r}
library(gam.hp)

mods <- c("mdensity", "mcom", "mthickness")

for (g in 1:length(mods)) {
  thisgam <- get(mods[g])
  
  hp <- gam.hp(thisgam, type = "dev")
  print(hp)
  plot(hp, plot.perc = TRUE)
  
  hp_tab <- as.data.frame(hp$hierarchical.partitioning)
  total_dev_expl <- summary(thisgam)$dev.expl
  hp_tab$contribution_to_total_deviance <- total_dev_expl * hp_tab$I.perc / 100
  hp_tab$percentage_total_dev <- hp_tab$contribution_to_total_deviance * 100
  
  rn <- row.names(hp_tab)
  f1 <- function(x) {
    if (substr(x, 1, 1) == 's') {
      out <- strsplit(substr(x, 3, nchar(x)), ',')[[1]][1]
    } else {
      out <- x
    }
    return(out)
  }
  f2 <- Vectorize(f1)
  hp_tab$var_name <- f2(rn)
  
  hp_tab_g <- hp_tab[order(hp_tab$percentage_total_dev, decreasing = TRUE), ]
  hp_tab_g$var_nameF <- factor(hp_tab_g$var_name, levels = hp_tab_g$var_name)
  
  p <- ggplot(hp_tab_g, aes(var_nameF, percentage_total_dev)) +
    geom_col(col = 'black', fill = 'lightgrey') +
    theme_bw() +
    ylab('Total deviance explained (%)') +
    xlab('Explanatory variable') +
    ggtitle(g) +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 16)
    )
  
  ggsave(
    here::here('plots', paste0(mods[g], '_relative_contribution.png')),
    plot = p
  )
}
```


##Pairwise comparisons
```{r}
# --- Pairwise marginal prediction heatmaps -----------------------------------
# For each pair of predictors, a 50×50 grid is evaluated; all other predictors
# are held at their means. Fill is sqrt-scaled to reduce dominance of the
# seasonal peak.

# Predictor means (used to hold non-focal variables constant)
means <- dat |>
  summarise(across(c(hour, day_of_year, solar_lux, lunar_lux, ice, BD, Bm_D), mean, na.rm = TRUE))
vars <- c("hour", "day_of_year", "solar_lux", "lunar_lux", "ice", "BD", "Bm_D")

make_bivariate <- function(var1, var2, n = 50,model,dat) {
  v1_seq <- seq(min(dat[[var1]], na.rm = TRUE), max(dat[[var1]], na.rm = TRUE), length.out = n)
  v2_seq <- seq(min(dat[[var2]], na.rm = TRUE), max(dat[[var2]], na.rm = TRUE), length.out = n)
  
  grid <- expand.grid(v1 = v1_seq, v2 = v2_seq)
  
  names(grid) <- c(var1, var2)
  for (v in setdiff(vars, c(var1, var2))) grid[[v]] <- means[[v]]
  print(head(grid))
  pr <- predict(model, newdata = grid, type = "link", se.fit = FALSE)
  grid$fit  <- exp(pr)
  grid$var1 <- var1
  grid$var2 <- var2
  grid
}


```
# Krill density
```{r}
library(patchwork)
full_grids <- list()
ms_rows <- list() 

vars <- c("hour", "day_of_year", "solar_lux", "lunar_lux", "ice","BD","Bm_D")
means <- dat |>
  summarise(across(c(hour, day_of_year, solar_lux, lunar_lux, ice, BD, Bm_D), mean, na.rm = TRUE))
pairs <- combn(vars, 2, simplify = FALSE)

short_labels <- c(
  hour        = "Hour",
  day_of_year = "Day of year",
  solar_lux   = "Solar lux",
  lunar_lux   = "Lunar lux",
  ice         = "Ice", 
  BD = "BD",
  Bm_D = "Bm_D"
)


for (g in 1:length(mods)) {
  thisgam <- get(mods[g])

  biv_df <- lapply(pairs, function(p) make_bivariate(p[1], p[2],dat=dat,
                                                   model=thisgam)) |> bind_rows()

  cat("Pairs computed:", length(pairs), "\n")
  cat("Total rows:", nrow(biv_df), "\n")

  short_labels<-c(short_labels,c('BD','Bm_D'))
  names(short_labels)[6:7]<-c('BD','Bm_D')
  
  z_rng<-range(biv_df$fit)
  
  n_vars <- length(vars)

# Build 7×7 grid: lower triangle = heatmap, diagonal = label, upper = spacer
grid_plots <- vector("list", n_vars ^ 2)
range(biv_df$fit)
for (col in seq_len(n_vars)) {
  for (row in seq_len(n_vars)) {
    idx <- (row - 1) * n_vars + col
    
    if (row == col) {
      grid_plots[[idx]] <- ggplot() +
        annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
                 label = short_labels[vars[row]], size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
        theme_void()
      
    } else if (row > col) {
      v1 <- vars[col]   # x-axis variable (column)
      v2 <- vars[row]   # y-axis variable (row)
      df <- biv_df |> filter(var1 == v1, var2 == v2)
      
      p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[v1]], y = .data[[v2]], fill = fit)) +
        geom_raster(interpolate = TRUE) +
        geom_contour(aes(z = fit), colour = "white", alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.3) +
        scale_fill_viridis_c(
          option = "magma",
          trans = "log",
          limits = z_rng,
          name = mods[g],
          labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1)
        )
      theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
        theme(axis.title  = element_blank(),
              plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2))
      
      # Suppress axis text except on outer edges
      if (row != n_vars) p <- p + theme(axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
                                        axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
      if (col != 1)      p <- p + theme(axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
                                        axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
      
      grid_plots[[idx]] <- p
      
    } else {
      grid_plots[[idx]] <- plot_spacer()
    }
  }
}

p_final <- wrap_plots(grid_plots, ncol = n_vars) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Pairwise marginal predictions from krill swarms",
    subtitle = paste0(mods[g], " | other vars held at their means")
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_final
```

## Recall sensitivity analysis
```{r}
#Based on min and max recall values from 

#Literature values
minR_bmd = 0.64 #Miller et al 2022 #https://zslpublications.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1002/rse2.297
maxR_bmd = 0.99  #Miller et al 2022 #https://zslpublications.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1002/rse2.297
minR_abz = 0.4 # Miller et al 2026 #https://besjournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/2041-210x.70331
maxR_abz = 0.8 # Miller et al 2026 #https://besjournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/2041-210x.70331
minR_bd = 0.78 #Summer, https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/mms.70118
maxR_bd = 0.87 #Winter, https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/mms.70118



#minR_bmd = 0.24 
#maxR_bmd = 0.99
#minR_abz = 0.195 
#maxR_abz = 0.99
#minR_bd = 0.78 #Summer, https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/mms.70118
#maxR_bd = 0.87 #Winter, https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/mms.70118

SA <- c()
SA <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    Bm_Ant_ABZ_minR = (Bm_Ant_ABZ * (1 - Bm_Ant_ABZ_rate)) / minR_abz,
    Bm_D_minR       = (Bm_D       * (1 - Bm_D_rate))       / minR_bmd,
    BD_minR         = (BD         * (1 - BD_rate))         / minR_bd,
    Bm_Ant_ABZ_maxR = (Bm_Ant_ABZ * (1 - Bm_Ant_ABZ_rate)) / maxR_abz,
    Bm_D_maxR       = (Bm_D       * (1 - Bm_D_rate))       / maxR_bmd,
    BD_maxR         = (BD         * (1 - BD_rate))         / maxR_bd
  )

ABZrecall <- ggplot(data = SA)+
  geom_point(aes(x=timeStamp, y=Bm_Ant_ABZ, colour = 'Raw'), size = 0.8, alpha = 0.3)+
  geom_point(aes(x=timeStamp, y=Bm_Ant_ABZ_minR,  colour = 'R = MIN'), size = 0.8, alpha = 0.3)+
  geom_point(aes(x=timeStamp, y=Bm_Ant_ABZ_maxR,  colour = 'R = MAX'), size = 0.8, alpha = 0.3)+
  theme_minimal()

Bm_Drecall <- ggplot(data = SA)+
  geom_point(aes(x=timeStamp, y=Bm_D, colour = 'Raw'), size = 0.8, alpha = 0.3)+
  geom_point(aes(x=timeStamp, y=Bm_D_minR,  colour = 'R = MIN'), size = 0.8, alpha = 0.3)+
  geom_point(aes(x=timeStamp, y=Bm_D_maxR,  colour = 'R = MAX'), size = 0.8, alpha = 0.3)+
  theme_minimal()

BDrecall <- ggplot(data = SA)+
  geom_point(aes(x=timeStamp, y=BD, colour = 'Raw'), size = 0.8, alpha = 0.3)+
  geom_point(aes(x=timeStamp, y=BD_minR,  colour = 'R = MIN'), size = 0.8, alpha = 0.3)+
  geom_point(aes(x=timeStamp, y=BD_maxR,  colour = 'R = MAX'), size = 0.8, alpha = 0.3)+
  theme_minimal()

ABZrecall / Bm_Drecall / BDrecall

```
